# oneuptime_alert (Resource)

Alert resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "oneuptime_alert" "example" {
  title = "This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field."
  alert_severity_id = "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"
}
```
